Now let's 10x this. I'm Javed. I invested 14 crore in a tech startup, it blew up, and now I'm worth 10,000 crore.

Same debt trick, bigger numbers. A 2% loan against my portfolio gives me 200 crore in tax-free cash. CGT hits 0% after six years, so my portfolio grows way faster than my interest rate.

I live in F-6 Islamabad. Six bedrooms, a massive four-kanal estate, worth 250 crore. It's got a pool, a private garden, and a basement entertainment complex. It's one of seven homes I own — Dubai Marina, London Mayfair, a Lahore farmhouse, Punjab farmland.
